verdict.justification: Deliverable A is more comprehensive, accurate, and better organized than Deliverable B. On the slide dedicated to the number of incidents per supplier (Slide 3), Deliverable A provides a complete breakdown for all 12 suppliers split by RMAs and Work Orders, whereas Deliverable B only lists the top three in text and makes an arithmetic error by stating 'Seven suppliers have 1 to 4' (there are actually nine remaining suppliers). Deliverable B also contains an inaccuracy on Slide 5, claiming that 'Lost customer profit on the Aperion wrong-part-number order is mentioned but not quantified,' when those four rows actually have $1,000 recorded each in the Resolution Cost column (which Deliverable A accurately identifies). Furthermore, Deliverable A includes a very useful Supplier Scorecard (Slide 7) and places its data quality caveats on a dedicated slide near the end rather than cluttering the executive summary using first-person pronouns ('I treated them as $0') like Deliverable B does.
